introduction: The merge_operations spec defines how multiple agent branches are integrated into a target branch within a workspace using rebase-then-fast-forward semantics, serialized execution via a durable job queue, and structured conflict reporting. Note: requirements referencing go-git, GitRunner (spec 11), and durable job queue (spec 10) APIs are based on PRD descriptions and should be cross-checked against installed library versions before implementation.

glossary.AlreadyMerged: A typed merge rejection reason indicating the source branch is already integrated into the target branch; the merge handler returns success idempotently.
glossary.AuthInfo: The authentication context object populated by apikit containing the authenticated user's identity information.
glossary.BranchNotReady: A typed merge rejection reason indicating the source branch has no commits ahead of the target branch; the merge handler returns a retryable error.
glossary.CHECK_COMMAND: A workspace variable (stored via the secrets/variables system) containing a shell command run between rebase and merge to validate the rebased state.
glossary.EnqueueParams: The parameter struct passed to the durable job queue's enqueue function, extended by this spec with an optional Group field for serialization.
glossary.GitRunner: The git subprocess runner from spec 11 used to execute git CLI commands (rebase, merge-tree, checkout, reset) that go-git cannot perform.
glossary.WORKSPACE_ROOT: The root directory on the hub host under which workspace clones are stored, with each workspace at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/.
glossary.WouldConflict: A typed merge rejection reason indicating that a dry-run conflict check detected merge conflicts before any real git operation was attempted.
glossary.afc: The af-hub command-line interface tool used by operators and agents to interact with the hub.
glossary.base_sha: The 40-character hex SHA of the target branch HEAD before the merge, returned in the merge job success result.
glossary.batch rebase: An operation that rebases a list of source branches onto a target ref, reporting per-branch results and continuing past individual branch conflicts.
glossary.conflict_files: The list of file paths reported as conflicting during a dry-run or real rebase conflict detection.
glossary.dead_letter: A terminal job status indicating the job has exhausted all retries and will not be retried again.
glossary.go-git: A pure-Go git implementation library used for fetch, ref updates, and branch deletion operations.
glossary.group serialization: The job queue dispatch mechanism that prevents two jobs with the same type and group_key from running simultaneously.
glossary.group_key: A column added to the jobs table that enables serialization of jobs sharing the same type and group, allowing multiple jobs to be queued while only one runs at a time per group.
glossary.merge job: A background task of type 'merge' registered with the durable job queue that executes the rebase-then-fast-forward merge algorithm for a given source and target branch.
glossary.merge-tree: The git subcommand (git merge-tree --write-tree) used for read-only conflict detection without modifying the working tree.
glossary.merged_sha: The 40-character hex SHA of the target branch HEAD after the merge (the rebased source HEAD), returned in the merge job success result.
glossary.merges:read: The PAT permission scope that grants read-only access to merge job status and listing.
glossary.merges:write: The PAT permission scope that grants the ability to submit and cancel merge jobs and trigger batch rebase operations.
glossary.pre-rebase SHA: The commit SHA of the source branch captured immediately before the rebase step, used to roll back the branch ref and working tree if the check command fails.
glossary.rebase: The git operation that replays commits from a source branch on top of a target ref, used to linearize history before fast-forward merging.
glossary.resolveCloneAuth: The credential resolution helper from the workspace checkout spec (spec 05) used to authenticate git fetch operations.
glossary.source_ref: The name of the source branch to be merged into the target branch.
glossary.submitted_by: The username of the authenticated user who submitted the merge job, stored in the job payload for attribution.
glossary.target_branch: The name of the integration branch into which the source branch is merged.
glossary.trunk: The non-bare working tree directory within a workspace clone, located at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/, where git operations are performed.
glossary.workspace_slug: The URL-safe identifier for a workspace, used in API paths and job queue keys.

requirements.title: Jobqueue Group Extension: Schema and EnqueueParams

user_story.goal: add a group_key column to the jobs table and a Group field to EnqueueParams
user_story.benefit: so that merge jobs can be serialized per target branch while allowing multiple merges to the same target to be queued simultaneously

acceptance_criteria.action: add a group_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' column to the jobs table
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: migration completes without error; existing rows have group_key = ''
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the database schema is initialized or migrated

acceptance_criteria.action: store the Group value in the group_key column of the inserted job row
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job row has group_key equal to the supplied Group value
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller passes a non-empty Group value in EnqueueParams

acceptance_criteria.action: store an empty string in the group_key column, preserving existing dedup behavior via (type, key)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job row has group_key = ''
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller omits the Group field in EnqueueParams

acceptance_criteria.system: durable job queue worker dispatch query
acceptance_criteria.action: use CASE WHEN jobs.group_key != '' THEN jobs.group_key ELSE jobs.key END as the serialization key, blocking dispatch when another job of the same type and effective serialization key is already running
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: at most one job per (type, effective serialization key) runs at a time
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the worker selects the next job to run

acceptance_criteria.action: preserve existing per-key serialization for all job types that do not set group_key, with no behavioral change to previously registered job types
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: all existing job types continue to serialize by (type, key) as before

edge_cases.action: skip the column addition without error using an idempotent migration strategy
edge_cases.return_contract: migration succeeds; no duplicate column error is raised
edge_cases.error_condition: the jobs table already has a group_key column from a previous partial migration

edge_cases.action: dispatch only one; hold the other in queued state until the running job completes or fails
edge_cases.return_contract: only one job transitions to running status at a time per (type, group_key)
edge_cases.error_condition: two merge jobs with the same type and group_key are both in queued status

user_story.goal: register a 'merge' job type with the durable job queue at boot
user_story.benefit: so that merge operations are executed durably and serially per target branch

acceptance_criteria.action: register a job handler for type 'merge' with the durable job queue, using the merge algorithm as the handler function
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the 'merge' job type is registered before the first request is served
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the server boots

acceptance_criteria.action: set Key to '<workspace_slug>:<target_branch>:<source_ref>' and Group to '<workspace_slug>:<target_branch>' for every merge job
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job row has the correct key and group_key values

edge_cases.action: return an error or panic at startup to prevent silent misconfiguration
edge_cases.return_contract: server fails to start with a clear error message indicating duplicate registration
edge_cases.error_condition: the 'merge' job type is registered more than once during boot

requirements.title: Merge Job Payload and submitted_by Resolution

user_story.goal: have the merge job payload include workspace_slug, target_branch, source_ref, and submitted_by
user_story.benefit: so that the merge handler has all context needed and attribution is recorded

acceptance_criteria.action: set submitted_by to the username from AuthInfo
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job payload JSON contains submitted_by equal to the API key owner's username
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a merge job is enqueued via an API key

acceptance_criteria.action: set submitted_by to the literal string "admin"
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job payload JSON contains submitted_by = "admin"
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a merge job is enqueued via an admin token

acceptance_criteria.action: set submitted_by to the PAT owner's username from AuthInfo
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job payload JSON contains submitted_by equal to the PAT owner's username
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a merge job is enqueued via a PAT

edge_cases.action: reject the enqueue request with an internal server error
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 500; no job is enqueued
edge_cases.error_condition: AuthInfo does not contain a resolvable username

user_story.goal: run a pre-check before attempting the real merge and return a typed rejection reason
user_story.benefit: so that expected rejections are distinguished from unexpected failures without string parsing

acceptance_criteria.action: return WouldConflict as a permanent error with the list of conflict_files
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job transitions to failed status with structured error containing conflict file paths; no git state is modified
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the dry-run conflict check detects conflicts

acceptance_criteria.action: return AlreadyMerged and mark the job as completed successfully without performing any git operations
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job transitions to completed status; no git state is modified
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the source branch is already integrated into the target branch

acceptance_criteria.action: return BranchNotReady as a retryable error
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job is retried by the job queue; no git state is modified
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the source branch has no commits ahead of the target branch

edge_cases.action: return a permanent error indicating the branch was not found
edge_cases.return_contract: job transitions to failed status with error message identifying the missing branch
edge_cases.error_condition: the source or target branch ref does not exist in the workspace repository

edge_cases.action: return a retryable error so the job is retried after the clone becomes ready
edge_cases.return_contract: job remains in retryable state; no git state is modified
edge_cases.error_condition: the workspace clone directory does not exist or is not a valid git repository

user_story.goal: run git merge-tree --write-tree before any real rebase to detect conflicts
user_story.benefit: so that the target branch is never left in a dirty state by a failed merge attempt

acceptance_criteria.action: invoke GitRunner with 'git merge-tree --write-tree <target-head> <source-branch-head>' in the workspace trunk directory
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: GitRunner returns exit code 0 (no conflicts) or a non-zero exit code with conflict file paths
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the pre-check phase runs

acceptance_criteria.action: parse the output to extract conflict_files and return WouldConflict as a permanent error
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job fails permanently with structured error containing conflict_files list; working tree is unmodified
acceptance_criteria.trigger: git merge-tree --write-tree exits with a conflict exit code

acceptance_criteria.action: proceed to the fetch step of the merge algorithm
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: no error; merge algorithm continues
acceptance_criteria.trigger: git merge-tree --write-tree exits with code 0

edge_cases.action: GitRunner kills the subprocess and returns a timeout error; the merge handler returns a retryable error
edge_cases.return_contract: job is retried; working tree is unmodified
edge_cases.error_condition: git merge-tree --write-tree hangs or does not return within the GitRunner timeout

edge_cases.action: GitRunner returns a non-zero exit code; the merge handler returns a permanent error indicating unsupported git version
edge_cases.return_contract: job fails permanently with error message indicating git >= 2.38 is required
edge_cases.error_condition: the installed git version is older than 2.38 and does not support git merge-tree --write-tree

requirements.title: Merge Algorithm: Fetch, Rebase, Check, Update, Delete

user_story.goal: execute the full merge algorithm: fetch, rebase, check command, ref update, source branch deletion
user_story.benefit: so that agent branches are cleanly integrated into the target branch with no lost work or dirty state

acceptance_criteria.action: fetch the latest target branch state from the upstream remote via go-git using resolveCloneAuth credentials
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: local target branch ref is updated to the latest remote state; no error returned
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the pre-check passes

acceptance_criteria.action: capture the pre-rebase SHA of the source branch, then invoke GitRunner to run 'git rebase <target-ref>' on the source branch in the workspace trunk directory
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: source branch is rebased onto target; pre-rebase SHA is stored for potential rollback
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the fetch step completes successfully

acceptance_criteria.action: execute CHECK_COMMAND via 'sh -c <CHECK_COMMAND>' in the workspace trunk directory with MERGE_TARGET, MERGE_SOURCE, and WORKSPACE_SLUG environment variables injected, enforcing a 10-minute timeout
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: check command exits 0; merge algorithm proceeds to ref update step
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the rebase completes without conflicts and CHECK_COMMAND is set in workspace variables

acceptance_criteria.action: skip the check step and proceed directly to the ref update step
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: no check command is executed; merge algorithm continues
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the rebase completes without conflicts and CHECK_COMMAND is not set

acceptance_criteria.action: update the target branch ref to the rebased source HEAD via go-git reference update
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: target branch ref points to the new merged SHA; this is a local ref update with no remote push
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the check command exits 0 (or is skipped)

acceptance_criteria.action: delete the source branch ref from the local repository via go-git reference deletion
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: source branch ref no longer exists in the workspace repository
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the target branch ref update succeeds

acceptance_criteria.action: return success with base_sha (pre-merge target HEAD) and merged_sha (new target HEAD)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: job transitions to completed status with result JSON containing base_sha and merged_sha as 40-char hex SHAs
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the source branch deletion succeeds

edge_cases.action: invoke GitRunner to run 'git rebase --abort' in the workspace trunk directory, then return a permanent error with the conflicting file paths
edge_cases.return_contract: job fails permanently; source branch is restored to pre-rebase state; working tree is clean
edge_cases.error_condition: git rebase encounters conflicts

edge_cases.action: invoke GitRunner to run 'git checkout <source-branch> && git reset --hard <pre-rebase-sha>' in the workspace trunk directory to restore the source branch ref and working tree, then return a permanent error with the check command output
edge_cases.return_contract: job fails permanently; source branch ref and working tree are restored to pre-rebase state; check output is included in the error
edge_cases.error_condition: the check command exits with a non-zero exit code

edge_cases.action: kill the check command process, roll back the rebase using 'git checkout <source-branch> && git reset --hard <pre-rebase-sha>', and return a permanent error indicating timeout
edge_cases.return_contract: job fails permanently; source branch is restored; error message indicates check command timed out after 10 minutes
edge_cases.error_condition: the check command does not complete within 10 minutes

edge_cases.action: return a retryable error so the job queue retries the merge job
edge_cases.return_contract: job remains retryable; target branch ref is unchanged
edge_cases.error_condition: the go-git reference update fails due to ref lock contention or other transient error

edge_cases.action: return a retryable error
edge_cases.return_contract: job is retried; no git state is modified
edge_cases.error_condition: the go-git fetch from the upstream remote fails due to network error or authentication failure

edge_cases.action: log the rollback failure with the original error and the rollback error, and return a permanent error indicating the repository may be in an inconsistent state
edge_cases.return_contract: job fails permanently with error message indicating rollback failure and repository state uncertainty
edge_cases.error_condition: the rollback command 'git checkout <source-branch> && git reset --hard <pre-rebase-sha>' fails

edge_cases.action: GitRunner kills the subprocess after its configured timeout; the merge handler runs 'git rebase --abort' and returns a retryable error
edge_cases.return_contract: job is retried; working tree is cleaned up
edge_cases.error_condition: GitRunner subprocess hangs during rebase and does not return

user_story.goal: rebase a single source branch onto a target ref
user_story.benefit: so that branch rebase is available as a reusable building block

acceptance_criteria.action: invoke GitRunner to run 'git rebase <target-ref>' on the source branch in the workspace trunk directory
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns the new branch HEAD SHA as a 40-char hex string on success
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller invokes the rebase operation with a source branch and target ref

acceptance_criteria.action: invoke GitRunner to run 'git rebase --abort', then return a structured conflict report containing the list of conflicting file paths; the branch is left in its pre-rebase state
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (empty SHA, RebaseConflictError) with conflict_files populated; branch ref is unchanged

edge_cases.action: return an error without invoking GitRunner
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (empty SHA, ErrRefNotFound)
edge_cases.error_condition: the source branch ref does not exist

edge_cases.action: GitRunner kills the subprocess after its timeout; the rebase operation runs 'git rebase --abort' and returns an error
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (empty SHA, timeout error); working tree is cleaned up
edge_cases.error_condition: GitRunner subprocess hangs during rebase

user_story.goal: rebase a list of branches onto a target ref in a single operation
user_story.benefit: so that multiple agent branches can be rebased independently without one conflict blocking others

acceptance_criteria.action: rebase each branch onto the target ref sequentially; on conflict for any branch, abort that rebase, record the conflict, and continue with remaining branches
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a per-branch result list where each entry has branch name, status ('ok' or 'conflict'), new_head (on success), and conflict_files (on conflict)
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller provides a list of branches and a target ref

acceptance_criteria.action: process each branch independently so that a conflict on one branch does not prevent rebasing of subsequent branches
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: all branches in the input list appear in the result list regardless of individual success or failure

edge_cases.action: return an error without performing any git operations
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with error message 'branches list must not be empty' when called via REST API; returns an error value when called as a library function
edge_cases.error_condition: the branches list is empty

edge_cases.action: record that branch as failed with status 'error' and message 'branch not found in workspace repository', then continue with remaining branches
edge_cases.return_contract: result entry for the missing branch has status 'conflict' or 'error' with a descriptive message; other branches are still processed
edge_cases.error_condition: a branch in the list does not exist in the workspace repository

edge_cases.action: GitRunner kills the subprocess after its timeout; that branch is recorded as failed; remaining branches continue to be processed
edge_cases.return_contract: timed-out branch has an error result; subsequent branches are not blocked
edge_cases.error_condition: GitRunner subprocess hangs for one branch during batch rebase

user_story.goal: submit a merge request via POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges
user_story.benefit: so that agent branches can be merged into the target branch programmatically

acceptance_criteria.action: enqueue a merge job with the correct Key, Group, and payload, then return the job ID and initial status
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 202 with JSON body containing the merge job record including id, status='queued', workspace_slug, target_branch, source_ref, submitted_by, created_at, updated_at
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges with valid target_branch and source_ref

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the request with HTTP 409
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 409 with JSON error body
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: a merge job for the same source_ref and target_branch in the same workspace is already queued or running

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the request with HTTP 400
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body indicating which field is missing
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: target_branch or source_ref is missing from the request body

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 404
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 404 with JSON error body
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the workspace identified by :slug does not exist

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 400
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body indicating workspace is not active
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the workspace is not in active status

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 400
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body indicating clone is not ready
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the workspace clone is not ready

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 400
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body identifying the missing branch
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the source or target branch does not exist in the workspace repository

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 403
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 403 with JSON error body
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the caller is a PAT without merges:write scope

edge_cases.action: return HTTP 400
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the request body is malformed JSON

edge_cases.action: enqueue exactly one job; return HTTP 409 for the duplicate
edge_cases.return_contract: one request returns HTTP 202; the other returns HTTP 409
edge_cases.trigger: two concurrent POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges requests arrive with the same source_ref and target_branch

requirements.title: REST API: List and Get Merge Jobs

user_story.goal: list and retrieve merge job status via GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges and GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id

acceptance_criteria.action: query jobs of type 'merge' scoped to the workspace and return them as merge job response objects
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON array of merge job records, each containing id, workspace_slug, target_branch, source_ref, status, base_sha, merged_sha, conflict_files, check_output, error, retry_count, submitted_by, created_at, updated_at
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges

acceptance_criteria.action: retrieve the job record by ID scoped to the workspace and return it as a merge job response object
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON merge job record; returns HTTP 404 if the job ID does not exist in the workspace
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges/:id

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 403
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 403 with JSON error body
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the caller is a PAT without merges:read scope

edge_cases.action: return an empty array
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {results: []}
edge_cases.trigger: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/merges is called when no merge jobs exist for the workspace

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 409 indicating the job cannot be cancelled in its current state

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 403
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 403 with JSON error body
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the caller is a PAT without merges:write scope

edge_cases.action: return HTTP 404
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 404 with JSON error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the merge job ID does not exist or belongs to a different workspace

user_story.goal: trigger a batch rebase via POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebase

acceptance_criteria.action: execute the batch rebase operation and return per-branch results synchronously

acceptance_criteria.trigger: a caller sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebase with a valid target_ref and non-empty branches list

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 400 without performing any git operations
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 403

acceptance_criteria.action: return HTTP 400

correctness_properties.title: At most one merge per target branch runs simultaneously
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one merge job with group_key = '<workspace_slug>:<target_branch>' is in running status at any given time

correctness_properties.title: Dedup prevents duplicate merge jobs
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one non-terminal job with Key = '<workspace_slug>:<target_branch>:<source_ref>' exists in the jobs table at any time

correctness_properties.title: Working tree is clean after any merge outcome
correctness_properties.invariant: after the merge handler returns (success or failure), the workspace trunk directory contains no uncommitted rebase state or partial merge artifacts

correctness_properties.title: Pre-rebase SHA is captured before any git mutation
correctness_properties.invariant: the pre-rebase SHA of the source branch is read before any GitRunner invocation that modifies the branch, ensuring rollback always targets the correct commit

correctness_properties.title: Source branch is deleted only after successful ref update
correctness_properties.invariant: the source branch ref is deleted if and only if the target branch ref update has already succeeded

correctness_properties.title: Batch rebase processes all branches regardless of individual failures
correctness_properties.for_any: batch rebase input list of N branches
correctness_properties.invariant: the result list always contains exactly N entries, one per input branch, regardless of how many branches conflict or fail

correctness_properties.title: group_key extension is backward compatible
correctness_properties.for_any: job type that does not set group_key
correctness_properties.invariant: the effective serialization key equals the job's key column value (CASE WHEN group_key != '' THEN group_key ELSE key END evaluates to key), preserving pre-extension behavior

correctness_properties.title: AlreadyMerged is idempotent
correctness_properties.for_any: merge job where the source branch is already integrated into the target
correctness_properties.invariant: the merge handler returns success without modifying any git state

execution_paths.title: End-to-end: CLI merge submit through job execution to completion

steps.action: runs 'afc merge submit my-workspace --target main --source feature/agent-1'
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/merges with body {target_branch: 'main', source_ref: 'feature/agent-1'}

validates workspace exists and is active, verifies both branches exist, resolves submitted_by from AuthInfo, and calls the durable job queue enqueue with type='merge', Key='my-workspace:main:feature/agent-1', Group='my-workspace:main'
inserts job row with group_key='my-workspace:main', returns job ID; returns HTTP 202 to CLI with queued job record
prints the merge job record including id and status='queued' to stdout
dispatches the merge job when no other merge job with group_key='my-workspace:main' is running
runs pre-check: invokes GitRunner (spec 11) with 'git merge-tree --write-tree main feature/agent-1'; detects no conflicts
fetches latest target branch state from upstream remote via go-git using resolveCloneAuth credentials
captures pre-rebase SHA of feature/agent-1, then invokes GitRunner (spec 11) with 'git rebase main' in the workspace trunk directory
reads CHECK_COMMAND from workspace variables (spec 07); if set, executes it via 'sh -c <CHECK_COMMAND>' with MERGE_TARGET, MERGE_SOURCE, WORKSPACE_SLUG injected and 10-minute timeout
updates the main branch ref to the rebased HEAD via go-git reference update
deletes the feature/agent-1 branch ref via go-git reference deletion
marks job as completed with result JSON containing base_sha and merged_sha
runs 'afc merge status my-workspace <job-id>' and sees status='completed' with base_sha and merged_sha

execution_paths.title: Merge rejected due to conflict: dry-run detection path

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/merges with {target_branch: 'main', source_ref: 'feature/conflicting'}
validates request, enqueues merge job, returns HTTP 202 with queued job record
dispatches the merge job
invokes GitRunner (spec 11) with 'git merge-tree --write-tree main feature/conflicting'; receives non-zero exit code with conflict file list
returns WouldConflict permanent error with conflict_files; working tree is unmodified
marks job as failed with structured error containing conflict_files
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/merges/:id and receives status='failed' with conflict_files populated
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebase with {target_ref: 'main', branches: ['feature/a', 'feature/b', 'feature/c']}
validates workspace is active and clone is ready, then invokes the batch rebase operation
invokes GitRunner (spec 11) to run 'git rebase main' for feature/a; succeeds and records new_head SHA
invokes GitRunner (spec 11) to run 'git rebase main' for feature/b; detects conflict, runs 'git rebase --abort', records conflict_files
invokes GitRunner (spec 11) to run 'git rebase main' for feature/c; succeeds and records new_head SHA
returns HTTP 200 with results array containing per-branch status, new_head, and conflict_files

execution_paths.title: Check command failure with rebase rollback

steps.action: dispatches a merge job for feature/agent-2 into main
dry-run passes; fetches latest main; captures pre-rebase SHA of feature/agent-2
invokes GitRunner (spec 11) to run 'git rebase main' on feature/agent-2; rebase succeeds
reads CHECK_COMMAND from workspace variables (spec 07); executes 'sh -c <CHECK_COMMAND>' with injected environment variables
exits with non-zero code; check output is captured
invokes GitRunner (spec 11) to run 'git checkout feature/agent-2 && git reset --hard <pre-rebase-sha>' in the workspace trunk directory
returns permanent error with check output; source branch is restored to pre-rebase state
marks job as failed with error containing check output

error_handling.condition: git merge-tree --write-tree detects conflicts during dry-run
error_handling.behavior: merge handler returns WouldConflict as a permanent error with conflict_files; job transitions to failed; working tree is unmodified

error_handling.condition: git rebase encounters conflicts during the real rebase step
error_handling.behavior: merge handler invokes GitRunner to run 'git rebase --abort', then returns a permanent error with conflicting file paths; job transitions to failed; source branch is in pre-rebase state

error_handling.condition: check command exits with non-zero exit code
error_handling.behavior: merge handler runs 'git checkout <source-branch> && git reset --hard <pre-rebase-sha>' via GitRunner to restore source branch and working tree, then returns permanent error with check output; job transitions to failed

error_handling.condition: check command does not complete within 10 minutes
error_handling.behavior: merge handler kills the check process, rolls back the rebase, and returns a permanent error indicating timeout; job transitions to failed

error_handling.condition: go-git reference update fails due to lock contention or transient error
error_handling.behavior: merge handler returns a retryable error; job queue retries the job; target branch ref is unchanged

error_handling.condition: go-git fetch from upstream remote fails
error_handling.behavior: merge handler returns a retryable error; job queue retries the job; no git state is modified

error_handling.condition: rollback command fails after check command failure
error_handling.behavior: merge handler logs both the original error and the rollback error, returns a permanent error indicating the repository may be in an inconsistent state; job transitions to failed

error_handling.condition: duplicate merge job submitted for same source_ref and target_branch in same workspace
error_handling.behavior: REST API returns HTTP 409; no new job is enqueued
REST API returns HTTP 404 with JSON error body

error_handling.condition: workspace is not in active status
error_handling.behavior: REST API returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body indicating workspace is not active
REST API returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body indicating clone is not ready

error_handling.condition: source or target branch not found in workspace repository
error_handling.behavior: REST API returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body identifying the missing branch

error_handling.condition: PAT caller lacks required permission scope
error_handling.behavior: REST API returns HTTP 403 with JSON error body

error_handling.condition: batch rebase request has empty branches list
error_handling.behavior: REST API returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body; no git operations are performed

error_handling.condition: GitRunner subprocess hangs during rebase and does not return
error_handling.behavior: GitRunner kills the subprocess after its configured timeout; merge handler runs 'git rebase --abort' and returns a retryable error; job is retried

error_handling.condition: source branch has no commits ahead of target (BranchNotReady)
error_handling.behavior: merge handler returns BranchNotReady as a retryable error; job queue retries the job; no git state is modified
